text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, May 1, 2018 Posted by admin on May 1st, Visa (V). down -79 points.
Monday the Dow was down -148.04 (-0.61%) at 24,163.15.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -2.25%.
There were 5 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) +5.77% and Apple (AAPL) +1.81%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Verizon (VZ) -4.30% and Microsoft (MSFT) -2.40%.
Apple (AAPL +1.81%) was rated a new ‘Buy’ at D.A. Davidson with a price target of $220.
European stocks are higher unchanged reported open of $1.05, beating estimates calling for $1.004 per share.
Pfizer (PFE) reported open of $0.77, beating estimates calling for $0.757 per share.
